environment.description: CLI tool deployed on EC2 instance (m5.large) in public subnet with IGW route, IMDSv1 enabled (HttpTokens=optional), instance profile attached with ssm:* permissions. Binary compiled with gcc -O2 (no stack canary, no ASLR via personality flag in systemd unit). Tool invoked by Lambda-triggered SSM RunCommand with user-supplied parameters from API Gateway.

config.network: public subnet, 0.0.0.0/0 -> igw, security group allows all outbound
config.invocation: SSM RunCommand with untrusted input from API Gateway
